fields.System.Title: TRF-103 — Query transfer status from both sites
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager at either site, I want to see where a transfer has got to, so
that the destination knows what to expect and when.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a transfer reference, then both origin and destination staff can see its state,
  • lines, dispatched quantities, and received quantities.
  • - Given a dispatched transfer, then the expected arrival date is shown.
  • - Given a partly received transfer, then outstanding quantities are shown per line.
  • - Given a discrepancy, then it is visible to both sites, not only to the one that
  • raised it.
  • - Given the query, then it is built so it would still work if the two sites later ran
  • separate databases.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers |
| Tables | transfer_order, transfer_shipment, transfer_receipt |
| Risks | Sites disagreeing about state ([doc 09 §9.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
